mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in housing starts, as measured by HOUST, indicates a growing demand for housing and, by extension, a robust economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong housing starts growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate, FEDFUNDS, rises above 4.5%, it signals a tightening monetary cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of high federal funds rates (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate, UNRATE, above 6% indicates a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of high unemployment rates (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production, INDPRO, below 100 indicates a slowing supply chain, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of low industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When both housing starts, HOUST, and retail sales, RSAFS, are increasing, it indicates a strong demand for goods and services, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong demand growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate, FEDFUNDS, below 2% indicates an easing monetary cycle, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of low federal funds rates (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate, UNRATE, is below 5% and payroll employment, PAYEMS, is increasing, it indicates a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong labor market growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in GDP, GDPC1, below 2% indicates a slowing economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of low GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).
